theme: An open day with a single call to anchor it.
greeting: A wide-open Monday, Dan — one short call with Mike is the only fixed point on the calendar. With the girls at Jen's this week, the rest of the day is yours to spend.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Mike's pre-op details
needsAttention.detail: Mike's oral surgery is Thursday in Portland, and today is the day to confirm fasting and medication instructions with the surgeon's office. The prep task has been open since Aug 14.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: Eugenia offered to reconnect on PRI either today between 12 and 2 ET or Thursday — she is waiting on you to choose a slot.

needsAttention.title: Book the Croatia flights
needsAttention.detail: The flights-to-Croatia task was due Aug 15 and is still open; fares tend to climb the longer it sits.

schedule.title: Call with Mike
schedule.detail: You phone Mike; the Sustainalytics client idea he forwarded is likely on the agenda.

flagged.title: Peter's LinkedIn message
flagged.detail: A message from Peter is waiting for a reply in LinkedIn.

flagged.title: Unverified work-authorization request
flagged.detail: An 'interview update' for an SVP Global Public Policy role asks you to confirm work authorization through a link — verify the sender before clicking.

flagged.title: Talkiatry follow-up tomorrow
flagged.detail: A virtual visit with Dr. Snowden is set for Tuesday at 10 AM ET.

flagged.title: Morningstar exits stewardship
flagged.detail: Mike flagged that Sustainalytics is closing its stewardship arm and floated reaching out to its stranded clients.

flagged.title: Amex autopay and a proxy notice
flagged.detail: Your Amex autopay processed and a Morgan Stanley proxy notice arrived — both informational.

inbox.noise: The usual reading pile — NYT Cooking, WSJ, The New Yorker, Responsible Investor — plus LinkedIn job alerts and a parking receipt.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply.

recipe.title: Olive oil–poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Peak-summer zucchini and just-picked tomatoes, softened slowly in good olive oil — exactly the unhurried supper a quiet Maine evening is asking for.

acts.line: The morning is open — nothing on the calendar before midday.
A single call anchors the afternoon, then the day clears.
The girls are with Jen this week, so the evening is unclaimed.
